pairs.en:
Move tool (M)
Use this to move or copy selections
Hold Ctrl to copy selections
Hold Ctrl+Shift to copy selection, and keep the old selection

移动工具（M）
使用此工具移动或复制选区
按住 Ctrl 复制选区
按住 Ctrl+Shift 复制选区并保留原选区

pairs.en:
Paste tool
Select a region, and press Ctrl-X or Ctrl+C to cut or copy the selection and open this tool.
Then click any location in your reactor to paste the selection in multiple places.
Press Escape or select a different tool when done.
Press Ctrl+V to ready the most recently copied selection
pairs.zh:
粘贴工具
选择区域后，按 Ctrl+X 或 Ctrl+C 剪切或复制选区，并打开此工具。
然后单击反应堆中的任意位置，将选区粘贴到多个位置。
完成后按 Esc 或选择其他工具。
按 Ctrl+V 准备最近复制的选区

pairs.en:
Pencil tool (P)

Hold CTRL to only place blocks where they are valid

使用此工具逐个绘制方块
按住 Ctrl 仅在有效位置放置方块

pairs.en:
Line tool (L)
Use this tool to draw blocks in a line through the multiblock

pairs.en:
Select tool (S)
Use this to select areas of the reactor
Ctrl-click to select multiple selections
Shift-click to select Groups of blocks that require each other
Alt-click to select clusters
Edits can only be made inside of selections (unless there are no selections)
Press Delete to delete the selected area
Press Escape to clear selection
pairs.zh:

使用此工具选择反应堆区域
按住 Ctrl 单击可选择多个选区
按住 Shift 单击可选择相互依赖的方块组
按住 Alt 单击可选择簇
只能在选区内编辑（没有选区时除外）
按删除键删除所选区域
按 Esc 清除选区
